verdict.rationale: Dagster's asset-based model inherently tracks dependencies between assets (deps=[...]) and integrations like dbt emit column-level lineage, giving strong support for lineage of what produced each table. However, evidence lacks explicit description of a dedicated lineage graph UI/visualization feature or cross-system lineage view beyond code-level dependency declarations. missing for 10: explicit UI lineage graph documentation, cross-pipeline/source system lineage visualization, independent hands-on confirmation of lineage UI usability.
